en: Hey,
About that warehouse of hidden gems I told you about,
did you go and see it?
You got to see some rare stuff, didn't you?

en: I'd recommend going to see it at least once.
has really become

en: It's been ages since anyone visited my home.
The shop gets customers every day, though.
Please do. It's my own place.
note: follows #1466 'If you'd like, stop by Cafe Jahn.' (slice 018)

en: A cafe... coffee, is it?
I'll be waiting, so be sure to come.
I'd love to see you.
What's wrong,
Do you need advice about something?
! What a surprise.
note: Name comes first in the message, so the 'it's you!' surprise follows it

en: Coming all this way just to visit me
makes me happy.
I'd be even happier if you came to the shop, though.
Well, you've come all this way.
Come on in and have some coffee.
It's on me, of course.
You thought I hadn't noticed,
did you?
By day you come to my shop so often,
and at night you kiss my neck...
No, I never meant to deceive you, Mr. Jahn...
note: [PLAYER] to Jahn; Mr. kept (polite young vampire)

en: You don't have to hide it anymore.
I felt it too, from the moment I first saw you.
Something just clicked.
I've decided to accept your love.
There's no need to hold back anymore.
(What do I do...)
I see, you'd rather I made the first move.
Waaah!
I'm sleepy.
I'm Klaus.
I work at the Coast Guard.
It really is a lovely morning.
Another lovely morning, isn't it?
How are you doing?
Oh, we haven't met before, have we?
We run into each other so often,
do we live near each other?
A fine evening, isn't it?
Another day has passed without incident.
This is the Coast Guard.
Has something happened?
No, of course not.
After all, Calstatt is a peaceful town.
Oh, hello there.
This is the Coast Guard, where I work.
You mustn't. When nothing has happened,
you shouldn't keep coming here.
Calstatt is a peaceful town, you see.
The sea is calm and the town is quiet today.
Calm, uneventful days just keep
going by, don't they?
(Enjoy these peaceful days
while you still can.)
Is something on my face?
No, it's nothing.
Every day is so uneventful, it gets boring.
You think it's an easy job, don't you?
<I don't think so>
<It must be boring>
Captain Stelan says Calstatt

en: On a day like this, I'd like to hurry home
and sit down to the dinner my wife made.
My wife's cooking is second to none.
I hear all sorts of rumors lately.
Suspicious people at the harbor, or at night
brawls breaking out...
